A skill with super high mobility. Using in the early game allows Helcurt to move through walls to speed up jungling. Using in middle-late game makes it a good initiating skill or escape by moving through terrains.

Up to 5 stingers can be stored for 8s, after which the number of stingers will decrease over time.\n(Active): Helcurt fires all (Deadly Stingers) in the target direction, each dealing 180( +80% Extra Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) to enemies (Minions and Creeps only take 70% of the damage) and slowing them by 8% for 3s (the slow effect can stack).\n(Deadly Stinger) counts as a Basic Attack, but it cannot Crit.
Storing up to 5 stingers to maximize the damage as it's the core damage skill. Since it can penetrate the targets, choose a good angle to hit more enemies or jungle monsters to speed up the jungling.

Helcurt summons the (Dark Night), greatly reducing all enemy heroes' sight range for 3.5s. He also gains 10% extra Attack Speed and 65% extra Movement Speed for 8s and 1 (Deadly Stinger). The number of Stingers won't drop during the night. (Dark Night Falls) has no effect on enemy Helcurt.\n(Passive): Helcurt's Attack Speed is increased by 10%.

Use it anytime anywhere to make all enemy heroes lose vision by 3.5s (except Helcurt). A very useful skill. The bonus movement speed allows him to go to the fight quickly or chase an enemy. The bonus attack speed substantially increases his burst damage. Let the enemies fear the invisibility. P.S: It's not effective on enemy Helcurt.

A very sick passive skill. This allows Helcurt to take damage from skills and silenced targets. P.S: Hitting by a long ranged skill will not trigger this passive!
